event.initial_firm_notification: Two or more of the following: Email, Fax, Letter, Press Release, Telephone, Visit
event.distribution_pattern: Product was directly distributed to California, Oregon, and Washington.

products.product_description: Truitt Brothers, Pacific Northwest Premium Navy Beans, net weight 15 oz. per metal can. The UPC is 0 82225 24145 1. The product is labeled in parts: "***TRUITT BROTHERS***Pacific Northwest PREMIUM NAVY BEANS***NET WT 15 OZ***INGREDIENTS: NAVY BEANS, WATER, SEA SALT, NATURAL CALCIUM CHLORIDE***TRUITT BROS., INC.***SALEM, OREGON 97308***www.truittbros.com***www.foodalliance.org***".
products.code_info: Can code: MDSB S1GTD best by 7/18/14. Code interpretation: MDSB is the internal code for this product. S = Salem, 1 = Year (2011), G = month, T = Day, D = Shift (of manufacture). Best by date is 7/18/14 (3 year shelf life)
products.reason_for_recall: Navy Beans with the can code MDSB S1GTD best by 7/18/14 are recalled due to undeclared soy. Truitt Bros,. Inc discovered that some canned chili beans were labeled as Navy Beans and soy was not declared on the Navy Beans label.
